items.text: The screens outside our rooms read your calendar feed and expect all-day bookings as midnight to midnight. Please leave that as it is.
URGENT: our front desk needs a compact week view that fits a whole day on one screen, before Friday.
Our payroll import reads the dates in your CSV export as month first, mm/dd, the way they come today. Please do not flip them to day first under us.
Can clients book 15-minute slots? 30 minutes is too long for our quick check-in calls.
Could the day view get a print button? Our front desk prints the day's bookings every morning.
People who booked with us can't cancel: the link in their confirmation email sends them to a login page.
